notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored (deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017, run retriage-drivers-1-036) and unreviewed; reviewed_by is null. The card's GymnasiumDriver helper fits the upstream Gymnasium environment, so there is no DEVIATION FROM THE CARD. The card's entry symbol robosynchallenge.tasks.click_bell.click_bell:ClickBellEnv was verified at click_bell.py:35 (registered ClickBell with max_episode_steps=600 at :34). Only ClickBellEnv is covered: ClickBellTest, ClickBellAgent and the other nine tasks and their gym ids are not. The clone stayed unmodified (G1 pass); no upstream code was imported or run and no hardware was attached.

NOT COVERED: the primary observation's camera streams (sensor/<camera>/color, 640x480 RGB in the random protocol); the button-press success path and the 0.0048 m contact; the real action space, its bounds and the active-joint order; EmbodiChain physics, contacts, the CobotMagic robot and the task reset randomizers. The fake is a pure-Python analytic contract stand-in, not a recording and not the upstream simulator: it has no robot, no physics, no camera and no torch, so the button never moves, is_task_success stays false and the reward is 0. Its step records the action as the next placeholder robot/qpos observation and advances one tick. The action space is a placeholder Box(-1, 1) with 14 values and is the one exception: the 14 values are sourced (configs/click_bell/action_config.json:2-56, docs/tutorials/configuration.md:319, robosynchallenge/replay.py:158) but the real bounds and joint order belong to the external EmbodiChain EmbodiedEnv and the CobotMagic robot, so action_space_ref is unset and the reference prints the derived action.values limit as 'no source: action_space of the fake backend .fake:FakeClickBellEnv'. The observation space is a placeholder Dict with only robot/qpos (14 values). The fake's reset draws a placeholder start jitter with Python random.Random; the fidelity gaps state all of this. The 361-step truncation is the deployed random protocol's max_episode_steps (configs/click_bell/random/gym_config.json:4), not the class default 600; the 40 ms timestep is the protocol's control_freq 25 recording period (configs/click_bell/random/gym_config.json:243), not a sourced EmbodiChain physics timestep. Fidelity is F0 (kinematic/analytic, no dynamics); snapshot/restore is not offered.

The sim backend (gym.make('ClickBell')) was not run: it needs EmbodiChain v0.2.4.post1, dexsim, a CUDA/Vulkan GPU, the CobotMagic assets, the upstream package imported for registration, and a cfg built by the EmbodiChain launcher (docs/getting_started/installation.md:3-93; scripts/eval_policy.py:468-472). Only the package fake backend exists. The fake was not compared with the upstream environment or any physical device, and fake evidence establishes no real ROS, simulator or hardware run.

Expected warnings of this Gymnasium family package: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only arms the next reset, so no native call), four G8.NO_UNIT for the bridge-derived integer inputs and action.values (the simulator's own units), and four G7.MAYBE_ABSENT for action_space, observation_space, step and close, because the upstream ClickBellEnv's base EmbodiedEnv lies outside the clone. There are no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. Only catalogue classes are used (cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1, cap.world.seed.v1), so there are no catalogue_requests. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package; gate.digest is the digest line the check printed and is unchanged while the package does not change.

MODEL REVIEW (gpt-6.1-sol, a model and not a human, 2026-11-17; reviewed_by stays null): Model review checked all fact citations, placeholder limits, fake semantics, stop/reset behavior, source pin and licence against the clone. Corrected driver.py and facts.md so inheritance, CLI defaults, source comments and seeding claims match their cited ranges, and scoped the latch claim to the fake contract with the external EmbodiChain lifecycle unverified. Extended test_driver.py to require a completed e-stop, refuse seed while latched and prove latch reset advances nothing. Regenerated reference.json, REFERENCE.md and check-report.json; the fake gate and strict collector pass, with contract_checked evidence only. For the human reviewer: Review covers the declared fake backend only. The automatic gym.make fallback requires registration, cfg, external EmbodiChain/dexsim and assets; its lifecycle and native stop were not run. ClickBellTestEnv, ClickBellAgentEnv and other tasks are outside coverage. The fake has placeholder action bounds and qpos only, no cameras or contact/success path; it cannot confirm the button was pressed.
